verses.gurmukhi: ਖਾਣਿ ਉਖਣਿ ਕਢਿ ਆਣਦੇ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕ ਹੀਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: khaan ukhan kadd aanadhe niramolak heeraa|

en.bdb: By digging into the mine the diamond is brought out.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਉਹਰੀਆ ਹਥਿ ਆਵਦਾ ਉਇ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: jauhareeaa hath aavadhaa ui gahir ga(n)bheeraa|

en.bdb: Then it goes into the hands of serene and great jewellers.
In the gatherings the kings and the ministers test and check it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਲੁ ਕਰਨਿ ਅਜਮਾਇ ਕੈ ਸਾਹਾ ਮਨ ਧੀਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: mul karan ajamai kai saahaa man dheeraa|

en.bdb: The bankers in full confidence evaluate it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਹਰਣਿ ਉਤੈ ਰਖਿ ਕੈ ਘਣ ਘਾਉ ਸਰੀਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: aharan utai rakh kai ghan ghaau sareeraa|

en.bdb: Putting it on the anvil by the strokes of hammers its body is tried for wounds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਰਲਾ ਹੀ ਠਹਿਰਾਵਦਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰਾ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit_en: viralaa hee Thahiraavadhaa dharageh gur peeraa ||16||

en.bdb: Any rare one remains intact. Likewise any rare one reaches the court of the Guru (God) i.e. any rare one escapes the darkness of maya and its infatuations.
